definition: Number of the 26 directional Table 3 targets on which the 95% percentile bootstrap interval of the model-minus-Uniform difference lies entirely on the better side (10,000 resamples of the sampling units shown). Not a cognitive score: targets differ in units, sample sizes and difficulty, and intervals are not adjusted for multiple comparisons.
